storeListing.subtitle: 漫畫太多？滑成條漫就好
storeListing.promotionalText: 漫畫多到像在考古？圖片資料夾、ZIP／CBZ 直接開，條漫一路滑，單頁、雙頁也免費。進度、收藏、搜尋都在同一個書架，原圖不用合併。
storeListing.description:
漫畫堆成山，找一本像在考古？你的收藏值得一個真正好用的書架。

G.A.I 直接讀取圖片資料夾與 ZIP／CBZ，照順序排好頁面。想一路滑，就用條漫；想慢慢翻，就切單頁或雙頁。不必事先把原圖合併成巨圖。

點進資料夾，先看眼前這一層；整個書庫在背景繼續掃。搜尋、收藏、閱讀進度與基本標籤幫你找回「上次看到哪本」。NAS 暫時離線，已整理的書庫紀錄也會留著。

基本閱讀免費：本機檔案、三種閱讀模式、進度、收藏、搜尋、基本標籤、資料匯出與基本復原都能用。透過系統檔案選擇器開啟已掛載的 NAS 資料夾，也在免費範圍。

想整理得更痛快？v1 Pro 一次買斷，沒有訂閱。解鎖直接 SMB／NAS 連線、批次標籤、進階整理、重複作品候選與 AI 解說／整理工具。

AI 是選用功能，須自備 OpenAI 或 Google API Key，確認供應商與傳送內容並同意後才會送出選取頁面與提示文字。Pro 不附 API 額度，供應商費用另計；AI 建議由你審核，不會直接蓋掉人工整理。

G.A.I 不提供漫畫下載、來源爬取或內容訂閱。請使用自己有權使用的檔案。

purposeAndTargetAudience.value: A general-purpose local-first comic library and reader for people who manage personal files on iPhone or iPad, including local folders, removable storage, and NAS. It is not a medical, professional, emergency, or social service.

setupAndAccess.value: The core reader is available for free without a purchase. The intended launch also includes a one-time v1 Pro purchase (no subscription and no bundled API quota) for direct SMB/NAS connections, batch tagging and advanced organization, duplicate candidates, and AI explanation/organization tools. On a clean install, open the clearly labeled built-in all-ages landscape demo with eight groups and 13 images; use the final submitted package to verify the exact demo contents. No purchase, subscription, demo credential, NAS, or external sample download is required to review the free core reader. A NAS folder already mounted through the system file picker remains part of the free core path and is not blocked by the Pro entitlement. The final package must provide reviewable StoreKit purchase, restore, offline-entitlement, and revocation behavior before submission. Purchased v1 Pro entitlements must remain available in supported later releases and must not be withdrawn because v2 ships or a new subscription is introduced. Direct SMB and optional AI are disclosed rather than hidden, but are not required for the free core review path.

externalServices.value: Core library indexing, reading, catalog metadata, and progress are local. Direct SMB uses the server selected by the user to scan or read selected files. AI is optional, cloud-only, and disabled until the user supplies an API key: OpenAI uses https://api.openai.com/v1/responses with GPT-6 Luna; Google uses https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent with Gemma 4. The launch specification includes no on-device model and no bundled API quota. Before either provider can be enabled, the app identifies the selected provider, states that selected page images (up to six for AI Scan) and the prompt may be sent to that provider, and requires explicit in-app consent for that session. Changing providers revokes the previous consent and requires a new confirmation. API keys are session-only by default; on iOS/iPadOS the user may explicitly store a key in the device Keychain for later use. A saved key does not restore consent; AI responses and candidates may be stored in local App Data for review. No app-owned analytics, advertising, login, or content-hosting service is claimed here; confirm the processed build before submission.

reviewInformation.appReviewNotesEnglish:
REVIEW VIDEO
A screen recording from a physical [TODO: device model] running iOS [TODO: OS version] is attached as [TODO: exact filename]. It starts from TestFlight build [TODO: version (build)], opens the built-in all-ages landscape demo on a clean install, demonstrates the library and image reader, and returns to Settings. The exact eight-group, 13-image demo contents must be verified against the final submitted package. The recording contains no real personal data, passwords, private NAS paths, or unlicensed review material.

TEST DEVICES AND OPERATING SYSTEMS
- Physical device: [TODO: iPhone/iPad model], iOS [TODO: version], app [TODO: version (build)].
- The minimum supported operating system is iOS 15.0; confirm this against the processed build.
- Additional simulator or desktop checks, if mentioned, are supplementary and do not replace the physical-device recording.

APP PURPOSE AND TARGET AUDIENCE
Gentlemen's Art Institute (紳士藝術研究所) is a general-purpose local-first comic library and reader for people managing their own files on iPhone or iPad. It indexes and reads user-selected image folders and ZIP/CBZ archives, keeps reading progress and catalog data locally, and can read from a user-selected mounted folder or optional SMB/NAS connection. It is not a medical, diagnostic, emergency, professional-advice, social, or content-hosting service.

ACCESS AND SETUP
The core reader is available for free without a purchase. The intended launch also includes a one-time v1 Pro purchase (no subscription and no bundled API quota) for direct SMB/NAS connections, batch tagging and advanced organization, duplicate candidates, and AI explanation/organization tools. On a clean install, open the clearly labeled built-in all-ages landscape demo with eight groups and 13 images; use the final submitted package to verify the exact demo contents. No purchase, subscription, demo credential, NAS, or external sample download is required to review the free core reader. Accessing a NAS folder that the user has already mounted through the system file picker remains part of the free core path and is not blocked by the Pro entitlement. The final package must provide reviewable StoreKit purchase, restore, offline-entitlement, and revocation behavior before submission. Direct SMB and optional AI are disclosed rather than hidden, but are not required for the free core review path.

EXTERNAL SERVICES AND TOOLS
Core indexing, reading, catalog data, and progress run locally. A user-selected SMB/NAS server is contacted only when the user configures it and requests a scan or read. Optional AI is disabled by default, cloud-only, and requires a user-supplied API key. The launch specification includes no on-device model and no bundled API quota. OpenAI requests use https://api.openai.com/v1/responses; Google requests use https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent. Before either provider can be enabled, the app identifies the selected provider, states that selected page images (up to six for AI Scan) and the prompt may be sent to that provider, and requires explicit in-app consent for that session. Changing the provider revokes the previous consent and requires a new confirmation. API keys are held for the app session by default; iOS/iPadOS users may explicitly save a key in the device Keychain. A saved key does not restore consent and keys are not included in review material; AI responses/candidates may remain in local App Data. The core reader does not require AI, analytics, advertising, third-party login, or an app-owned content server.

REGIONAL AVAILABILITY
There is no planned region-specific catalogue or core feature difference. The primary interface is Traditional Chinese (Taiwan). SMB and optional AI availability can depend on the user's network, region, account, and provider terms; neither is required for the core reader.

REGULATED INDUSTRY / PROTECTED CONTENT
Not applicable as a regulated service: the app provides no medical, diagnostic, emergency, financial, or other professional advice. The app does not bundle third-party comics or provide a source crawler/downloader, but it can display files selected by the user, including material for which the user must have appropriate rights. The attached recording uses only the bundled original all-ages landscape demo. Age rating, rights declarations, and App Privacy answers are based on the actual release build and distribution library and are [TODO: complete before submission].

Thank you for your guidance. We have added the requested information to App Review Information Notes for version [TODO: version (build)], including the physical test device and OS, app purpose and audience, setup and access instructions, external services, regional availability, and regulated/protected-content clarification.

We have attached [TODO: exact recording filename], a screen recording of the submitted build running on a physical [TODO: device model] with iOS [TODO: OS version]. It uses the safe, authorized eight-group landscape demo from the final package and contains no account credentials, private NAS paths, or personal data.

The core reader is available without purchase. The intended launch also discloses a one-time v1 Pro purchase (no subscription) for direct SMB/NAS, advanced organization, duplicate candidates, and AI explanation/organization tools. The final package must provide verifiable StoreKit purchase, restore, offline-entitlement, and revocation behavior; no current metadata claim should be read as evidence that StoreKit is already implemented.

Please let us know if any additional information is needed.
physicalRecordingScript: Start the recording on the physical device and show the app launch; do not replace the submitted build with a simulator or desktop build.
Show the empty or safe reviewer library and the main navigation without exposing private file paths, notifications, account names, or real NAS credentials.

Open the clearly labeled built-in all-ages landscape demo; no NAS, credentials, or external sample download is required for the free core review path. Verify the final package contains eight groups and 13 images.
Read the bundled landscape demo and demonstrate page navigation and only the reading controls that exist in the submitted build; do not use a prior demo as version evidence.
Show search, favorite, reading progress, and catalog/settings screens with synthetic titles; do not claim a feature that is not visible in this build.

If the final package has StoreKit, verify the one-time Pro purchase, restore, offline entitlement, and revocation/refund behavior. TestFlight must verify the full feature set and sandbox purchase flow; sandbox entitlements must not unlock Pro in production. Verify purchased v1 Pro remains available in supported later releases.

If demonstrating AI, first show that it is optional, show the selected provider and the page-image/prompt disclosure, then explicitly consent. Switch providers once to demonstrate that the previous consent is revoked. Use only a synthetic or authorized page. Do not demonstrate AI if the release build or reviewer notes do not declare the provider path.
If demonstrating direct SMB, state that the server is user-selected and show only a disposable review share; confirm the core reader also works with a local or mounted folder.
End in the app and inspect the exported movie for readable text, continuous physical-device evidence, no secrets, no private metadata, and no unlicensed or age-restricted review material.
